text: Hafen, Hafen. Spruch eins von drei. Gruppe folgt. Ende. (Harbour, harbour. Message one of three. Group follows. Out.)
Hafen, Hafen. Spruch zwei von drei. Gruppe folgt. Ende. (Harbour, harbour. Message two of three. Group follows. Out.)
Hafen, Hafen. Spruch drei von drei. Gruppe folgt. Ende. (Harbour, harbour. Message three of three. Group follows. Out.)
My set lost its valve. There is a spare in the radio room upstairs, on the desk. Bring it down, and I will listen for you.
Somebody is down. I heard it on the floor.
Sweep done. They are there, there, and there. Keep your eyes up.
It is speaking again. Someone is counting on this line.
Same voice, same smile. Someone is counting on this line, and I do not like who.
New traffic on the board. Here we go.
Amt switchboard, nobody answering. I keep the plugs warm anyway. Habit.
There is a voice on the line that is not ours. It counts. It says it is counting on us.
There. Hear that hum? One sweep, and I will tell you where they gather.
